profile.headline: Web Developer at Levy Online
profile.summary: I am Front End Web Developer with strong Graphic Design skills. I am experienced in HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript and frameworks and libraries such as JQuery, Bootstrap, WordPress, GSAP, Gulp, Webkit, and am always wanting to learn more. I use Git CLI for maintaining my project repos. I work hard to make sure I have clean, semantic, and discernible code, especially for working in a team environment. I am a strong team player and can fill in gaps as they come up. I think a healthy team environment fosters creative problem-solving and constructive feedback. I even enjoy some positive, friendly competition at times.

positions.title: Paid Intern / Front End Development / Mobile Development
positions.description:
I am part of a team creating a mobile and web application. My tasks include HTML/CSS production as as well as using Angular JS, Laravel/PHP, and Appgyver/Supersonic for creating our application. 

I also create page layout and design using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator for myself and other developers to use as a guide in creating views for web and mobile.

Skills:
Vanilla Javascript
JQuery
Angular JS
Laravel/PHP
Appgyver/Supersonic

Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator

positions.title: Content Developer
positions.description:
As a Content Developer for OutletPC, I created original content for product pages with an emphasis on SEO, audit sections and edit/update descriptions as necessary, as well as created and tested emails for promotions and new and bestselling items.

I was also given other tasks, including creating new CG graphics for the website through the use of Adobe Photoshop or Adobe Illustrator, in-house images for merchandise, designing and developing pages or page sections for the website, and box-art for our own branded merchandise.

positions.title: Clerk
positions.description:
As a clerk at CCS Gunsmithing, I organized about a year to two years worth of paperwork for gun sales and repairs. 

I also reorganized storage for guns that were to be repaired to ensure ease of visibility of the order number on the storage tags. 

Other tasks involved gun break down and deep cleaning, sand blasting, chrome polishing, parts replacement, and test firing.

positions.title: Lifeguard / Lead Lifeguard / Water Safety Instructor
positions.description:
I worked in this position sporadically as I completed highschool and attended college. 
Years worked include 2005, 2007, 2009, and 2010. 2005 was October into November. The other years were for the summer season between school being in session. 

Tasks included:

• Pool Supervision
• Pool/Deck Maintenance
• Rotation Management
• Manage Water Safety Courses
• Teach Water Safety Courses
• Student Paperwork Filing
• ID Check
• First Aid
• CPR/Rescue Breathing
